narrative: The June 2 order pairs a CISA federal-civilian hardening directive with a frontier-model benchmarking-and-designation process and is explicitly cast as the executive-branch counterpart to the congressional AI-governance debate. That executive-order-plus-operational-directive-plus-parallel-congressional-track combination matches the coupled multi-instrument shape the prediction expects the US oversight stack to settle into.
remaining_gap: The actual instruments diverge from the predicted FMRB-EO, House joint resolution, and compliance-directive triplet, and a voluntary cyber order is not yet a settled review-board oversight regime.
